info.title: Sketch2Life API
info.description:
Sketch2Life API for classroom management, collaborative learning, and the Lesson Library.

Protected operations require a valid bearer token. Examples illustrate request and response shapes; they do not create database records. Use IDs available in your environment. Local operations depend on the selected app profile and configured services.

StoryRun-lite routes are an unauthenticated, loopback-only synthetic demo; they do not establish a real Parent identity.

**Access:** a valid bearer token and a Teacher or School Admin assignment for the class. Effective group consent and an existing checkpoint are required. This operation is available in local/test until production checkpoint storage is configured.
